milestones.description: Uses position_inside_box because the info dict has no 'is_riding_entity' field, so the best available proxy is checking that the player's position is at the minecart's location on the rail track. When a player rides a minecart, their reported position snaps to the minecart entity's position. The box is centered tightly around the minecart at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4) covering the rail track area. This is a movement/navigation-adjacent task (player must physically reach and mount the minecart), making position_inside_box the appropriate rule type.
